residue.statement: The Language Project owns the product package, but no Language Runtime system-design or implementation owner has been admitted.
residue.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 Language Project owner plus CyberAlchemy v2 product owner
residue.next_action: Select the Language Runtime owner and implementation Project before Runtime Contract acceptance or code work.

residue.statement: This typed graph supplies candidate Runtime Contract subjects, but no closed Language Runtime Contract has been authored or accepted.
residue.owner_route: selected CyberAlchemy v2 Language Runtime owner
residue.next_action: After owner selection, author one closed JSON Runtime Contract from this graph and route its acceptance separately.

residue.statement: The package uses active DS-D1 types and DS-D8 relationships through the candidate complete-backend-criteria@2 formation projection. Release admission is not granted and compiler conformance is not evaluated.
residue.owner_route: DomainSpec v2 minted-project profile and compiler owners
residue.next_action: Do not claim DomainSpec compiler or release conformance; evaluate a minted-project carrier only after the runtime owner selects that consumer path.

residue.statement: No transition kernel, session schema, repository, JSON replacement protocol, test, telemetry, CLI, chat adapter, artifact emitter, or executable evidence exists in this package.
residue.owner_route: selected CyberAlchemy v2 Language Runtime owner
residue.next_action: Implement only after an accepted Runtime Contract and exact implementation work unit exist.

residue.statement: The graph has strong overlap with the prior Define System Runtime ontology, but it does not decide whether Language Runtime remains Language-specific, becomes Define, or is adopted by Define later.
residue.owner_route: Invoke product or domain owner plus CyberAlchemy v2 Language Project owner
residue.next_action: Use the first experiment to decide ownership and adoption before merging identities or moving the implementation package.

residue.statement: Interactive CLI and chat are product-system candidates, but Layer 0 exposes only one internal transport-neutral interface and Question View. No IPC socket or external transport is selected.
residue.owner_route: selected CyberAlchemy v2 Language Runtime owner plus future chat integration owner
residue.next_action: Validate the pure transition and serialized Question View first; add presentation adapters only when a selected experiment or product slice requires them.

residue.statement: Answer, defer, withdraw, challenge, review, and resume are preserved as candidate command kinds, but exact per-kind payload, authorization, transition, rejection, and output rules are not yet a closed Runtime Contract.
residue.owner_route: selected CyberAlchemy v2 Language Runtime owner plus bounded-context meaning owner
residue.next_action: Specify and negatively test each command kind in the Runtime Contract; unsupported kinds must fail closed rather than receive guessed behavior.

residue.statement: Layer 0 starts from one validated Language Session State. Creation of the initial state, initial question, identity allocation, and source-selection rules are deliberately outside this graph.
residue.owner_route: selected CyberAlchemy v2 Language Runtime owner
residue.next_action: Bind an exact initial-state fixture in the experiment protocol before deciding whether session creation belongs in this runtime.

residue.statement: Preview, review, and materialization are modeled as a candidate extension after the pure transition/store proof. They are not part of the minimum transition kernel and cannot be implemented implicitly with it.
residue.owner_route: selected CyberAlchemy v2 Language Runtime owner plus Invoke output owner
residue.next_action: Keep candidate emission in a separate work unit after deterministic transition and restart continuity pass their own evidence gates.

residue.statement: The Governance Policy exercise is the proposed semantic fixture, but there is no Experiment record, protocol, executable binding, admitted run, observation, finding, or generalization decision.
residue.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 Language Project owner plus selected Language Runtime owner
residue.next_action: Author the separate Experiment record after Runtime Contract acceptance, then bind exact executable and input digests immediately before an admitted run.

residue.statement: The persistence model assumes one local process, one writer, validated whole-state replacement, and local JSON. It does not cover crash, power-loss, filesystem, hardware, database, concurrent-writer, or distributed durability.
residue.owner_route: selected CyberAlchemy v2 Language Runtime owner
residue.next_action: Re-distill the store and conflict model before adding a second writer, asynchronous chat mutation, database, or remote process.

residue.statement: The prior Define System Runtime ontology is reuse evidence only and its current validator reports upstream source drift, stale receipt currency, and DomainSpec compilation not evaluable. This package cannot inherit a PASS from it.
residue.next_action: Treat reuse-map entries as candidates only until the prior package owner refreshes and independently validates its own package.

residue.statement: Persistent answers, evidence, owner references, and context have no accepted retention, redaction, deletion, provenance, or source-allowlist policy. Explicit answers must remain distinguishable from inferred context before chat integration.
residue.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus selected Language Runtime owner
residue.next_action: Define the source allowlist, retention boundary, redaction and deletion behavior, provenance contract, and explicit-answer marker in the Runtime Contract before storing chat-derived context.
